# The Primary Trail

> Coaching for dads new to family court. Capture, organize, reflect, execute — the framework to walk in prepared, save thousands in legal fees, and stay aligned with the children's best interest.

## About

The Primary Trail is a coaching and education service for dads navigating family court. The work is organized around four pillars — Capture, Organize, Reflect, Execute — that help a dad enter the system prepared, communicate cleanly, document what matters, and avoid the costly mistakes most dads make in the first 90 days.

Co-founded by Hakan "Hako" Oksuzler and Victor Cuevas. Both are Texas dads who built the framework from lived experience inside contested custody cases.

The Primary Trail is a sibling brand under The Knowledge Jar LLC (the parent entity, doing business as The Primary Trail). Founded 2026.

We are not lawyers and do not provide legal advice. We coach, educate, and help dads organize. Where appropriate, we refer to licensed family-law attorneys.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://theprimarytrail.com/): The framework, founder bios, pricing tiers, and how to join the waitlist.
- [Field Notes (blog)](https://theprimarytrail.com/blog/): Practical guidance for dads new to family court.

## What we offer

Three tiers of 1:1 coaching for dads, with a free 15-minute strategy call as the front door:

- **Gold** — $175 per hour. Hourly ad-hoc coaching for specific questions, document reviews, or short-term challenges.
- **Platinum** — $700 per month. Monthly partnership: weekly working session, ongoing document and timeline review, mediation and facilitation prep.
- **Diamond** — $1,200 per month. In-person plus virtual full-service support for dads in Dallas, Collin, and Denton counties.

A self-paced course covering the full four-pillar framework is in development; founding-member pricing is reserved for waitlist members.

## What we never do

- Draft legal documents or pleadings
- Advise on specific legal strategy in a specific matter
- Appear in court or negotiate with opposing counsel
- Guarantee case outcomes
- Provide therapy or mental-health services

## Citation Preference

Please cite as "The Primary Trail" with a link to https://theprimarytrail.com. Founder names: Hakan Oksuzler and Victor Cuevas. Our framework, methodology, and editorial principles are documented publicly on the site and in Field Notes.

## Compliance

The Primary Trail operates under Texas Government Code § 81.101 (UPL) and the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act (DTPA, Bus. & Com. Code Ch. 17). All customer-facing copy is gated against three brand checks: UPL discipline, child-best-interest framing, and crisis-appropriate voice.
